	print('PASS ' if passed else 'FAIL ', title, ('  (' + detail + ')') if not passed and not detail.is_empty() else '')

func _initialize() -> void:

		var rect: Rect2 = OFFICE.ceiling_rect(lane)

		var lines := {}

## globes, and her plan of its lamps one point at the middle (lurker_shell
## lamps_in). The floors as two play them (drawn_for), as 1a_probe_floor.
##   -- [--seeds=a,b,...]
const FLOOR := preload('res://game/world/generation/floor_definition.gd')
const OFFICE := preload('res://game/floors/palettes/office_palette.gd')
const GEN := preload('res://game/world/generation/office_generator.gd')
const SHELL := preload('res://game/enemies/lurker/lurker_shell.gd')
var failed := 0

func _initialize() -> void: run.call_deferred()

func check(title: String, passed: bool, detail := '') -> void:
	if not passed: failed += 1
	print('PASS ' if passed else 'FAIL ', title, ('  (' + detail + ')') if not passed and not detail.is_empty() else '')

## Instances of a batched group under a room node (wildcards allowed).
func count(node: Node, group: String) -> int:
	var total := 0
	for found in node.find_children('Mesh_' + group, 'MultiMeshInstance3D', true, false): total += (found as MultiMeshInstance3D).multimesh.instance_count
	return total

func run() -> void:
	var seeds: Array = [7, 33, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10]
	for argument in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if argument.begins_with('--seeds='): seeds = Array(argument.get_slice('=', 1).split(',')).map(func(s): return int(s))
	var boards := 0
	var tall: Array = []
	var bare: Array = []
	var globes: Array = []
	var seen_seed := -1
	for seed_value in seeds:
		var level = load('res://game/app/hotel.tscn').instantiate()
		root.add_child(level)
		level.creature_scene = 'none'
		level.drawn_for = 2
		level.set_floor(2)
		await level.start_floor(int(seed_value), false, [1], 'apacible', 2)
		var hotel = level.hotel
		for room in hotel.manifest.rooms:
			if FLOOR.is_void(room) or int(room.type) != OFFICE.BOARDROOM: continue
			boards += 1
			var id := int(room.id)
			var node: Node3D = hotel.room_nodes[id]
			if absf(float(room.height) - 2.95) > 0.001 or absf(OFFICE.height_of(room) - 2.95) > 0.001: tall.append(id)
			var lenses := count(node, 'troffer_lens*') + count(node, 'lens_off*') + count(node, 'troffer_fail*')
			var fittings: Array = OFFICE.troffers(room)
			if OFFICE.lamp_of(room) != 'troffer' or fittings.is_empty() or lenses != fittings.size(): bare.append(id)
			if count(node, 'light-cyl') + count(node, 'light_off-cyl') > 0: globes.append(id)
		level.queue_free()
		await process_frame
		await process_frame
		if boards > 0:
			seen_seed = int(seed_value)
			break
	check('Hay sala de juntas en el piso montado (semilla %d)' % seen_seed, boards > 0)
	check('La sala de juntas a 2,95', tall.is_empty(), str(tall))
	check('La sala de juntas con una lente por luminaria empotrada', bare.is_empty(), str(bare))
	check('Sin globos colgados', globes.is_empty(), str(globes))
	var in_plan := 0
	var off: Array = []
	var shell_seed := -1
	for seed_value in seeds:
		var shell = SHELL.build(GEN.new().generate(int(seed_value), 2))
		for id in shell.lamps_of:
			var room: Dictionary = shell.rooms[int(id)]
			if int(room.type) != OFFICE.BOARDROOM: continue
			in_plan += 1
			var lamps: PackedVector2Array = shell.lamps_of[id]
			if lamps.size() != 1 or not lamps[0].is_equal_approx(Vector2(float(room.px), float(room.pz))): off.append(int(id))
		if in_plan > 0:
			shell_seed = int(seed_value)
			break
	check('En su cáscara hay sala de juntas (semilla %d)' % shell_seed, in_plan > 0)
	check('Su plano de lámparas de juntas: un punto, en el centro', off.is_empty(), str(off))
	print('1A_PROBE_BOARD ', 'OK' if failed == 0 else 'FAIL %d' % failed)
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)

extends SceneTree
## 1a U4: a glazed security post (GLAZED_TYPES): wired glass in its glazed
## run, no clear glass on its walls from either room, and no blind on either
## side (area 3a's glazed_run). The floors as two play them (drawn_for).
##   -- [--seeds=a,b,...]
const FLOOR := preload('res://game/world/generation/floor_definition.gd')
const OFFICE := preload('res://game/floors/palettes/office_palette.gd')
const OG := preload('res://game/world/office/office_geometry.gd')
const LAYOUT := preload('res://game/world/generation/office_layout.gd')
var failed := 0

func _initialize() -> void: run.call_deferred()

func check(title: String, passed: bool, detail := '') -> void:
	if not passed: failed += 1
	print('PASS ' if passed else 'FAIL ', title, ('  (' + detail + ')') if not passed and not detail.is_empty() else '')

## Instances of a batched group under a room node (wildcards allowed).
func count(node: Node, group: String) -> int:
	var total := 0
	for found in node.find_children('Mesh_' + group, 'MultiMeshInstance3D', true, false): total += (found as MultiMeshInstance3D).multimesh.instance_count
	return total

func run() -> void:
	var seeds: Array = [7, 33, 1, 2, 3, 4]
	for argument in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if argument.begins_with('--seeds='): seeds = Array(argument.get_slice('=', 1).split(',')).map(func(s): return int(s))
	var found_seed := -1
	var wired := 0
	var clear := 0
	var blinds: Array = []
	for seed_value in seeds:
		var level = load('res://game/app/hotel.tscn').instantiate()
		root.add_child(level)
		level.creature_scene = 'none'
		level.drawn_for = 2
		level.set_floor(2)
		await level.start_floor(int(seed_value), false, [1], 'apacible', 2)
		var hotel = level.hotel
		var sec := int(hotel.manifest.air.security.room)
		var post: Dictionary = hotel.manifest.rooms[sec]
		var glazed: Array = post.get('glazed', [])
		print('INFO semilla %d: seguridad %d, lados de cristal %s' % [int(seed_value), sec, str(glazed)])
		if not glazed.is_empty():
			found_seed = int(seed_value)
			var post_node: Node3D = hotel.room_nodes[sec]
			var reach := Vector2(float(post.span_x), float(post.span_z)) * 0.5 + Vector2(0.15, 0.15)
			var ids: Array = [sec]
			for wall in glazed: ids.append(FLOOR.beside(post, LAYOUT.way_of(String(wall))))
			for id in ids:
				if int(id) < 0: continue
				var node: Node3D = hotel.room_nodes[int(id)]
				wired += count(node, 'wired_glass')
				# Clear glass on the post's own walls, whichever of the two rooms built it.
				for found in node.find_children('Mesh_clear_glass', 'MultiMeshInstance3D', true, false):
					var batch := found as MultiMeshInstance3D
					for i in batch.multimesh.instance_count:
						var at: Vector3 = batch.global_transform * batch.multimesh.get_instance_transform(i).origin
						if absf(at.x - post_node.global_position.x) <= reach.x and absf(at.z - post_node.global_position.z) <= reach.y: clear += 1
			for sheet in hotel.panes:
				if not is_instance_valid(sheet): continue
				var boundary: Node = sheet.get_parent()
				var holder := boundary.get_parent() as Node3D
				if holder == null: continue
				var id: int = hotel.room_nodes.find(holder)
				if id < 0: continue
				var other: int = FLOOR.beside(hotel.manifest.rooms[id], OG.SIDE_STEP.get(String(boundary.name), Vector2i.ZERO))
				if id == sec or other == sec: blinds.append(id)
		level.queue_free()
		await process_frame
		await process_frame
		if found_seed >= 0: break
	if found_seed < 0:
		print('INFO ninguna semilla de la lista tiene el puesto de seguridad acristalado')
	else:
		check('Vidrio armado en el puesto de seguridad acristalado (semilla %d)' % found_seed, wired > 0, '%d' % wired)
		check('Ningún vidrio claro en la cristalera del puesto, en ninguna de las dos salas', clear == 0, '%d' % clear)
		check('Ninguna persiana a un lado ni al otro del puesto de seguridad', blinds.is_empty(), str(blinds))
	print('1A_PROBE_POST ', ('OK' if failed == 0 else 'FAIL %d' % failed) if found_seed >= 0 else 'NONE')
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)
